updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Network Data Security Integration with Entra GSA Internet Access
updates.summary: Admins can now scope network data security DLP policies to all websites or exclude specific cloud apps through Entra Global Secure Access integration, extending protection beyond the Defender Cloud App Catalog. This enables more granular control over sensitive data exfiltration across web-based platforms and custom cloud services.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Apply Default SharePoint Library Labels to Data at Rest
updates.summary: SharePoint files can now be automatically labeled to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library, closing labeling gaps for inactive data. This reduces reliance on manual user labeling and ensures consistent protection across SharePoint libraries.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Rule-Based Alert Auto-Resolution and Tagging
updates.summary: DLP administrators can define rules to automatically resolve predictable low-severity alerts and tag alerts for routing without manual triage. This reduces alert fatigue and streamlines incident response workflows for security teams.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Optical Character Recognition (OCR) Support for Endpoints
updates.summary: DLP policies on Windows endpoints can now detect sensitive content embedded in images (JPG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, PDF) and prevent exfiltration. This extends data protection to visual content that previously evaded policy enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Sensitivity labels published in Purview now apply automatically to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups, extending classification and governance without separate configuration. This unifies labeling policy enforcement across groups and collaboration endpoints.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Export DLP and Label Policy Configurations
updates.summary: Administrators can now export DLP policies and label publishing configurations as a ZIP file from the Purview portal, streamlining troubleshooting and support escalation. This improves policy auditing and disaster recovery workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint Files under Retention Policies
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management now supports file archiving actions within retention policies for SharePoint Online, allowing admins to move inactive content to low-cost storage. This enables comprehensive content lifecycle governance while maintaining compliance and data discoverability.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Increase Expansion Limit for Auto-Expanding Archive Beyond 1.5 TB
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5 TB limit without becoming inoperative, enabling scalable retention for organizations with high data volume. This capability is available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Priority Content Support for Risky AI Usage
updates.summary: The Risky AI usage policy template now supports priority content filtering using Sensitive Info Types, Trainable Classifiers, and Sensitivity Labels. Admins can focus alerts on high-risk activities involving sensitive data rather than all AI interactions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Endpoint Temporary File Noise Reduction
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management introduces improved filtering for temporary files created by Windows and applications, reducing low-signal noise in Endpoint activity monitoring. This refinement helps security teams focus on genuinely suspicious insider behaviors.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) Evolution with AI Observability
updates.summary: Purview DSPM has been redesigned to unify visibility across traditional and AI-driven data environments with AI-assisted workflows and Security Copilot automation. This enhancement enables faster risk prioritization, triage, and remediation for organizations embracing AI.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Reporting
updates.summary: A new compliance report for Information Barriers policies identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply after policy changes. This helps admins track and remediate policy violations following configuration updates.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Network Data Security General Availability with Entra GSA Integration
updates.summary: Purview Network Data Security is now generally available, integrating with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect text, files, and AI interactions at the network layer and enforce DLP actions. This prevents sensitive data exfiltration across browsers, APIs, and generative AI platforms.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96940: Microsoft Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A weak authorization flaw in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to elevate privileges over the network. Admins should apply patches immediately to prevent unauthorized access escalation in on-premises or hybrid Exchange deployments.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69435: Azure SRE Agent Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authorization in Azure SRE Agent permits authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Organizations running Azure SRE Agent should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized privilege elevation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-94510: Microsoft Bookings Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authorization bypass in Microsoft Bookings via user-controlled keys allows unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Organizations using Bookings should apply available patches to remediate this access control vulnerability.

updates.title: CVE-2026-77900: Azure App Service Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure App Service allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code remotely over the network. This is a critical vulnerability affecting identity/access security; immediate patching is essential.

updates.title: CVE-2026-83947: Azure Event Grid Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authorization in Azure Event Grid permits authorized attackers to perform spoofing attacks over the network. Organizations relying on Event Grid for identity or messaging workflows should verify and apply patches.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62698: Microsoft Digest Authentication Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A weak authorization vulnerability in Microsoft Digest Authentication can permit attackers to escalate privileges. Admins using Digest Authentication in identity systems should review available patches and security guidance.
